# 🚀 Feature Request

Thank you for taking the time to suggest an idea to improve the project!  
Please fill out the details below so we can better understand your request.

---

## ✨ Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what the problem is.  
Example: *“I'm always frustrated when I can't see the weather forecast for the next few days.”*

---

## ✅ Describe the solution you'd like

A clear description of what you want to happen.  
Example: *“It would be great to show a 3-day forecast below the current weather data.”*

---

## 🔄 Describe alternatives you've considered

Did you think of any other solutions? Let us know.  
Example: *“Maybe link to a forecast page instead of showing it directly.”*

---

## 📸 Additional context (optional)

Add screenshots, sketches, or mockups if you have any.  
This helps visualize your idea!

---

Thanks again for your suggestion! 💡
